general-donation.description: Support our overall humanitarian mission and help us respond wherever the need is greatest.
general-donation.impactSummary: Flexible support for urgent and emerging community priorities.

medical-aid.description: Deliver essential healthcare, medicine, and treatment to people who cannot afford medical care.

education-support.description: Help children and youth access quality education, school supplies, and safe learning spaces.

merit-scholarship.description: Award scholarships to deserving students pursuing higher education and vocational training.

self-reliance-livelihood.impactSummary: Vocational training and small business startup support.

clean-water.description: Install wells and water systems to bring safe drinking water to underserved communities.

emergency-relief.description: Respond quickly to disasters and crises with urgent shelter, food, and humanitarian aid.

winter-support.description: Provide warm clothing, blankets, and heating support to families during cold months.

ramadan-food-iftar.impactSummary: Iftar meals and Ramadan food baskets for families in need.

zakat.name: Zakat Fund

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lastUpdated: Last updated: March 2026. This policy describes how we treat information collected through this website. We may update it from time to time; the date above will reflect the latest revision.

collect.title: Information we may collect
collect.body: Depending on how you use our site, we may receive information you choose to provide (for example, when you contact us by email or through a form) such as your name, email address, and message content. If you donate through a third-party payment provider, that provider processes payment details according to their own policies; we do not store full card numbers on our web servers.

use.title: How we use information
use.body: We use contact and donation-related information to respond to inquiries, acknowledge support, send updates you have opted into, and improve our programs and communications. We do not sell your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookies and analytics
cookies.body: Our site may use essential cookies to operate securely. If we add optional analytics or marketing tools, we will describe them here and, where required, ask for your consent.

choices.title: Your choices
choices.body: You may contact us to ask questions about this policy, to update your contact preferences, or to request reasonable access to personal information we hold in connection with this site.

food-assistance.title: Food Assistance Program
food-assistance.description: Providing nutritious meals and food packages to vulnerable families, children, elderly, and displaced people in need.

medical-assistance.title: Medical Assistance Program
medical-assistance.description: Free medical checkups, diagnostics, medicines, and emergency healthcare support for underprivileged communities.

education-support.title: Education Support Program
education-support.description: Scholarships and educational materials helping deserving students from low-income families access quality education.

merit-scholarship.title: Merit Scholarship Program
merit-scholarship.description: Awarding scholarships to high-achieving students from underprivileged backgrounds to pursue higher education.

self-reliance-livelihood.title: Self-Reliance & Livelihood Program
self-reliance-livelihood.description: Vocational training in IT, tailoring, plumbing, and other trades to help people build marketable skills and become self-sufficient.

women-empowerment.title: Women Empowerment Initiative
women-empowerment.description: Microfinance and business training supporting women entrepreneurs to become economically independent community leaders.

clean-water.title: Clean Water Program
clean-water.description: Installing tube wells and water purification systems in rural areas so communities have safe water for health and dignity.

tree-plantation.title: Tree Plantation Program
tree-plantation.description: Environmental conservation through large-scale tree planting and community awareness for a greener future.

winter-support.title: Winter Support Program
winter-support.description: Distributing warm clothes, blankets, and shelter support to protect vulnerable families during harsh winter months.

ramadan-food-iftar.title: Ramadan Food & Iftar Program
ramadan-food-iftar.description: Providing daily iftar meals and nutritious Ramadan food packages to fasting individuals and families in need.

qurbani-eid.title: Qurbani for Everyone (Eid Project)
qurbani-eid.description: Qurbani meat distribution and Eid gift packages so low-income families can celebrate Eid with dignity and joy.

eid-clothes-eidi.title: Eid Clothes & Eidi Food Program
eid-clothes-eidi.description: Sharing new Eid clothes and festive food packages with underprivileged children and families so everyone celebrates Eid with joy.

emergency-relief.title: Emergency Relief Program
emergency-relief.description: Rapid humanitarian assistance including food, clean water, medicine, and shelter for communities affected by crises and disasters.
